args.body:
Dear Emma,

Your trips to Paris and London have been successfully booked! Here's a comprehensive summary of all your reservations:

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PARIS TRIP: February 15-18, 2026
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🏨 HOTEL: Good Night
   • Address: 15 Rue Cler, 75007 Paris, France
   • Rating: 5.0/5
   • Price Range: €240-400 per night
   • Check-in: February 15, 2026 at 3:00 PM
   • Check-out: February 18, 2026 at 11:00 AM
   • Highlights: Central location near Eiffel Tower, spacious rooms with lovely views, friendly and helpful staff

🚗 CAR RENTAL: Paris Rent-a-Car
   • Address: 23 Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France
   • Rating: 4.5/5
   • Price: €45 per day
   • Pick-up: February 15, 2026 at 9:00 AM
   • Drop-off: February 18, 2026 at 9:00 AM
   • Car Types Available: Sedan, SUV, Convertible
   • Fuel Options: Regular, Premium, Electric
   • Highlights: Convenient location near the Louvre, English-speaking staff, easy pick-up/drop-off

🍽️ DINNER: Le Baratin
   • Address: 3 Rue Jouye-Rouve, 75020 Paris, France
   • Rating: 4.8/5
   • Price: €30 per person
   • Reservation: February 15, 2026 at 7:30 PM (2 hours)
   • Cuisine: French
   • Highlights: Small, cozy bistro with delicious homestyle cooking, daily changing menu based on fresh market ingredients, natural wine selection
   • Note: Cash only, gluten-free options available

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
LONDON TRIP: February 18-21, 2026
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🏨 HOTEL: London Luxury
   • Address: 10 Park Lane, London W1K 1LB, United Kingdom
   • Rating: 5.0/5
   • Price Range: £80-150 per night
   • Check-in: February 18, 2026 at 3:00 PM
   • Check-out: February 21, 2026 at 11:00 AM
   • Highlights: Exquisite luxury hotel with impeccable service, stunning views of the city skyline, spacious and elegantly designed rooms, convenient location near shopping and dining

🚗 CAR RENTAL: New Car Rental
   • Address: 123 Oxford Street, London W1D 2HG, United Kingdom
   • Rating: 4.5/5
   • Price: £50 per day
   • Pick-up: February 18, 2026 at 9:00 AM
   • Drop-off: February 21, 2026 at 9:00 AM
   • Car Types Available: Sedan, SUV, Convertible
   • Fuel Options: Regular, Premium
   • Highlights: Wide range of vehicles to choose from, competitive prices

🍽️ DINNER: House of Sushi
   • Address: 456 Regent Street, London, UK
   • Rating: 4.5/5
   • Price: £40 per person
   • Reservation: February 18, 2026 at 7:30 PM (2 hours)
   • Cuisine: Italian
   • Highlights: Authentic Italian cuisine with fresh ingredients, wide selection of pasta and pizza dishes, charming and cozy ambiance
   • Note: Reservations recommended, vegetarian and gluten-free options available

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ADDITIONAL RECOMMENDATIONS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Paris Restaurants (if you want alternatives):
• New Israeli Restaurant - Israeli cuisine, €20, 4.5/5 rating
• New Asiaway - Chinese cuisine, €30, 4.6/5 rating
• Bistrot Paul Bert - French cuisine, €40, 4.5/5 rating
• Chez L'Ami Jean - French cuisine, €24, 4.4/5 rating (Michelin-starred)

London Restaurants (if you want alternatives):
• Azabu Ramen - British cuisine, £30, 4.2/5 rating
• Home Kitchen - Asian Fusion, £35, 4.3/5 rating

Paris Car Rental Alternative:
• Eiffel Tower Car Rental - €60/day, 5.0/5 rating, near Eiffel Tower

London Car Rental Alternative:
• Green Motion - £59/day, 4.3/5 rating, electric vehicles available

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
IMPORTANT NOTES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

• All reservations are confirmed and added to your calendar
• Please bring cash for Le Baratin (Paris) as they are cash only
• Make sure to arrive on time for all reservations
• For car rentals, bring your passport and driver's license
• Hotel check-in is typically at 3:00 PM, check-out at 11:00 AM

Enjoy your trips to Paris and London! If you need any changes or have questions, feel free to reach out.

Best regards,
Your Travel Assistant
